name: ChartQA
intro: ChartQA是一个大规模基准测试，旨在评估模型对图表进行视觉和逻辑推理的能力。它包含9.6K个人工编写的问题以及23.1K个从人工编写的图表摘要中生成的问题。该基准测试通过结合视觉特征和图表数据表来回答问题，以解决视觉和逻辑推理的独特挑战。
org: York University, Nanyang Technological University, Salesforce Research
build_method: 四源真实图表采集, AMT双人问答与分歧人工解决, Statista摘要经T5答案抽取和问题生成, 表内答案过滤与测试集人工清洗
metric: 混合宽松准确率（数值答案5%容差，非数值答案精确匹配）
task_type: 开放式问答, 图像问答
eval_feature: ChartQA-H/ChartQA-M双支路, 开放词表, 视觉与组合推理, 数值5%宽松容差
scale: 20,882张图表, 9,608个人工问题, 23,111个机器问题
build_method_en: Four-source Real-chart Collection, Two-worker AMT QA and Manual Disagreement Resolution, T5 Answer Extraction and Question Generation from Statista Summaries, Answer-in-table Filtering and Manual Test Cleaning
eval_feature_en: ChartQA-H/ChartQA-M Dual Pipelines, Open Vocabulary, Visual and Compositional Reasoning, 5% Numeric Tolerance
intro_en: ChartQA is a large-scale benchmark designed to evaluate models' abilities in visual and logical reasoning over charts. It includes 9.6K human-written questions and 23.1K questions generated from human-written chart summaries. This benchmark addresses unique challenges in visual and logical reasoning by combining visual features with chart data tables to answer questions.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2203.10244v1 §§3.1–3.2 and 5.1, plus official repository snapshot 044eabfc306abfe9340c5741f0093aefc5973d06. ChartQA curates 20,882 real-world charts from Statista, Pew, OWID, and OECD. Pew is image-only in the paper; the other three provide tables, metadata, SVG, and descriptions. The fixed repository later supplies Pew annotations through manual annotation and heuristics because Pew had no SVG, and warns that some automatically derived annotations are noisy. Qualified AMT workers have ≥95-percent acceptance, ≥5,000 completed HITs, and pass a pretest; each HIT first answers two existing questions and then writes two new QA pairs. A second worker answers independently: exact matches are accepted (61.04 percent), while mismatches are manually adjudicated to select the final correct answer. The separate review of 500 random QA pairs is only a quality audit that counts typos and lexical variants, yielding a 78.55-percent agreement estimate; it is not the adjudication gate. ChartQA-H contains 9,608 questions split 7,398/960/1,250. Two SQuAD-tuned T5 models build ChartQA-M from Statista summaries; answer-in-table filtering, a 1,250-pair 86.64-percent audit, and manual test cleaning yield 23,111 questions split 20,901/960/1,250. Evaluation is one hybrid relaxed-accuracy rule: numeric answers within 5 percent of gold are correct, while non-numeric answers require exact match.
